bagPolicy.summary: Food City Center does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking information is not detailed on the website. Visitors are encouraged to plan their visit in advance and check for any updates or specific instructions regarding parking.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Food City Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Food City Center offers a variety of food and drink options to enhance the event experience. While specific vendors are not listed, attendees can expect a range of traditional concession stand offerings. Special promotions or unique food items may be available during certain events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Food City Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Food City Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Food City Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Food City Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
